exposure: Pre-eclampsia with IUGR vs. pre-eclampsia without IUGR
outcome: Number of NK cells in the decidua
Number of macrophages in the decidua
cohort: 30 pregnant women with pre-eclampsia and 20 healthy pregnant women
finding: Women with pre-eclampsia had a lower number of NK cells and a higher number of macrophages in the decidua compared to healthy controls, and these alterations were related to the degree of trophoblastic invasion.
